decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill a opponent's library. It also includes various support cards such as Goblin Welder, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Urza's Saga to help set up the combo and protect it. The inclusion of Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, and other removal spells help to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Broadside Bombardiers and City of Traitors provide additional utility and mana acceleration to further enhance the overall game plan of the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back into play using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the graveyard, the deck aims to cheat out expensive creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect its game plan and maintain control over the board.

The main strategy of this deck is to use a combination of fast mana acceleration and disruption to assemble the Doomsday combo. This combo involves using Doomsday to set up a specific sequence of cards, usually including Thassa's Oracle and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells and removal to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently set up the combo and win the game before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the "Show and Tell" card to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. By using cards like Sneak Attack and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with these high-impact creatures. Additionally, the deck includes 2 Omniscience to cast spells for free and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Will. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation through Ponder, Brainstorm, and Vexing Bauble to ensure consistency in executing the combo.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells to overwhelm opponents quickly. By utilizing cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats of its own. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland help to control the board and slow down the opponent's strategy. With powerful Eldrazi creatures and mana acceleration from cards like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple, this deck aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes a combo involving Leyline Binding and Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly establish a threatening board presence. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast opponents through meticulous planning and strategic play.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Utilizing cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the graveyard, the deck aims to reanimate high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. This strategy allows the player to bypass traditional casting costs and surprise the opponent with powerful threats early in the game. The inclusion of disruption cards like Daze and Thoughtseize helps protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of reanimation spells like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to cheat out powerful creature cards from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Troll of Khazad-dûm, to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo pieces and interact with the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm and Ponder helps to filter through the deck and find key combo pieces efficiently.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes a mix of cantrips, disruption, and fast mana to help find and protect the combo. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student adds a unique twist to the traditional Doomsday combo, allowing for additional card draw and filtering. It is a fast and consistent deck that aims to win as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The focus of this deck is to generate mana quickly through cards like Rite of Flame, Lotus Petal, and Seething Song, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Elemental Eruption and Ral, Monsoon Mage. The deck also utilizes Burning Wish to fetch specific combo pieces from the sideboard, while maintaining consistency with cards like Reckless Impulse and Vexing Bauble. City of Traitors and Sandstone Needle provide additional mana acceleration, while Wrenn's Resolve helps protect key combo pieces. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and powerful combo strategy centered around Ruby Storm.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures with disruptive abilities, such as Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher, while using cards like Chalice of the Void and Sowing Mycospawn to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal to cast its threats ahead of schedule. The inclusion of lands like Wasteland and Eye of Ugin help control the board and tutor for key Eldrazi creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells and efficient creatures to control the board and tempo of the game while applying consistent pressure on the opponent. By using a mix of counterspells, removal, card draw, and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually wearing them down. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing for a smooth curve and the ability to adapt to various situations. Overall, it aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of aggression and control elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to quickly cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play. It also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo from being disrupted by the opponent. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures before they have a chance to react. The use of cards like Wasteland and Daze also provides additional disruption and control over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting your opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure with aggressive creature and spell options. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, Fatal Push, and Force of Will to control the board, you can create openings for your aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to deal damage and secure victory. The deck also includes various card draw and library manipulation spells to ensure you have the cards you need to stay ahead of your opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play by utilizing the combo of Reanimate and Entomb. The deck uses various means such as Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier provide strong offensive capabilities once they hit the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption elements like Wasteland and Brazen Borrower to control the board and ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures like It That Heralds the End and Thought-Knot Seer, supported by mana acceleration from cards like Mox Diamond and Ancient Tomb. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Wasteland and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game through efficient plays and high-impact creatures. The mana base is structured to support the Eldrazi creatures and provide the necessary colors for spells while also offering some utility lands.
